name: Kuzhi Paniyaram
ingredients: Gingelly oil for greasing the pan
instructions: 1. Soak rice, urad dal, and fenugreek for 4-6 hours, then grind into a smooth, thick batter and allow it to ferment overnight.
2. Heat a small amount of oil in a pan and temper mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves, onions, and green chilies.
3. Add the sautéed mixture, grated coconut, and salt to the fermented batter and mix well.
4. Heat the Kuzhi Paniyaram pan and brush each cavity with oil.
5. Pour the batter into each cavity until three-fourths full.
6. Cook on medium-low heat until the edges turn golden brown, then flip carefully using a skewer to cook the other side until crispy.
description: Kuzhi Paniyaram is a traditional South Indian snack made from leftover idli or dosa batter. It is a staple in Tamil households, often served as a nutritious breakfast or tea-time snack accompanied by spicy coconut or tomato chutney.
